doc: Per (op_kind, ep_size, phase) correction factor: profiler median latency / aiconfigurator SOL alpha-beta latency at GLM-5 reference shape (H=6144, K=8, M=128 for decode, M=4000 for prefill). Each (ep, phase) is anchored to its OWN SOL — we don't divide through ep=1 (degenerate dispatch path) and we don't mix prefill vs decode (different M, different alpha/beta regimes). Apply as scalar multiplier on top of aiconfigurator's analytical comm model.
